units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:3">Macc. I, 3</cite> <he>שהוא חייב מ׳ ארבעים</he> that he (has done something for which he) is subject to forty lashes.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 4:3:2">Y. Naz. IV, 53ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מ׳ תורה ארבעים וכ׳</he> the Biblical punishment consists of thirty-nine lashes; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַלְקִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 81b:10">Snh. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ של כריתות</he> the punishment of lashes for offences punishable with extinction.
<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:22">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02544"><he>מַרְדּוּת</he> I</cite>; a. fr.
